designs.label: History statistics
designs.description: Learned categorical predictors using account and pair statistics; no neural memory or neighborhood aggregation.

designs.label: GRU memory
designs.description: Role-aware account memory with counterparty state messages; no neighborhood readout.

designs.label: GRU + graph mean
designs.description: GRU account memory plus two layers averaging direction-, amount-, and age-aware neighbor messages.

designs.label: GRU + graph attention
designs.description: Original design: GRU account memory plus two layers of learned temporal graph attention.

designs.label: XGBoost trees
designs.description: Offline second-order gradient-boosted trees trained on causal account and payment statistics using flagged historical outcomes.

designs.label: DyGFormer history
designs.description: Bounded temporal-history encoder with sinusoidal time features over recent account events; no mutable node memory.

designs.label: TAMI pair history
designs.description: Directed pair-keyed event history with elapsed-time encoding and bounded pair state.

designs.label: DyGFormer + TAMI
designs.description: Temporal account histories combined with directed pair histories before prediction.

designs.label: DyGFormer + TAMI + GNN
designs.description: Temporal histories and directed pair state combined with a two-hop time-respecting graph readout.
